about: KING FEVER fan versions of the anthem INQUILAAB KING KE SAATH. Fans submit a link through /ai-submit (note starts '#fever'); a version appears here only after review. Fields: sub_id (ai_submissions id), url, platform (youtube|instagram|x|facebook), handle, city, title, approved (YYYY-MM-DD). 'official' holds the owner's own versions shown above the lyrics (url empty = Coming soon).

official.title: Version 1 · composed by Pragnesh S. Singh
